mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, role_code, role_name, status, created_at, updated_at, version FROM sys_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, tenant_id, role_code, role_name, status, created_at, updated_at, version FROM sys_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{roleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role_code = #{roleCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (tenant_id, role_code, role_name, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, permission_code, description, created_at, updated_at, version FROM sys_permission WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY permission_code ASC

SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.role_code ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.tenant_id = rp.tenant_id AND p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.permission_code ASC

SELECT ur.user_id, r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id IN #{userId} ORDER BY ur.user_id ASC, r.role_code ASC

SELECT p.permission_code FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.tenant_id = rp.tenant_id AND p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.permission_code ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_user_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (tenant_id, user_id, role_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{roleId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_role_permission WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role_id = #{roleId}
